description:
Searches USDA FoodData Central by food name.

Each match has an fdc_id, its dataset, key macros per 100 g, and, for
branded products, USDA's verbatim ingredient statement.
ingredients_available is false when USDA supplied no ingredient statement
for that record. Results are paged, and pagination.next_offset is null on
the last page.

data_type.description: One USDA dataset. Foundation and SR Legacy are unbranded whole foods, Branded is packaged products, and Survey (FNDDS) is prepared dishes. Omitted, all four are searched.

offset.description: Results to skip, from pagination.next_offset. Defaults to 0.

query.description: Food name, e.g. raw spinach or cheddar cheese.

name: search_foods
title: Search foods
